'''Chief of Security''' or '''Security Chief''' was a title given to individuals responsible for the security and defense of various locations.

==History==
Until his death in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] was Chief of Security of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="DatabankCin">{{SWE|characters|cin-drallig|Cin Drallig}}</ref>
